PluginData.Author: RougeSable
PluginData.Tooltip: An in-game map of the solar system, with the real planet globe and the memory of what you have seen.
PluginData.Description:
Press M to open a full screen map of the solar system. While a block is held for building, M stays the game's symmetry switch.
The globe is the real planet, drawn by the game itself, for any planet including planets from world mods: zoom in down to your base, zoom out to the whole system at real scale, double-click a body to dive into it.
You are your own radar: every grid and character that enters your sync range is remembered at its last known position, with when you saw it ("seen today", "seen 3 days ago"). The memory is kept on your computer, per server and per world, and is never shared.
The view sits in its frame on the left; on the right, one tab gives the details of the selection and another lists the celestial bodies with their markers.
Your faction is GPS blue, your GPS keep their own color, other players are red and NPCs yellow. Click a marker to create a GPS to it, in the same color.
Client only: nothing runs on the server, and players without the plugin play normally.
